nav.title: Accordion
nav.description: One at a time, with no JS — the exclusivity is an attribute you can see.

nav.title: Alerts
nav.description: A template plus six lines of CSS — a coloured edge that is one token.

nav.title: Avatar
nav.description: One class, sized by a token — and the circle, the ring and the overlap are all CSS.

nav.title: Background
nav.description: A swappable layer behind your content — one div, ten kinds, no images.

nav.title: Badges
nav.description: A template plus four variant classes — the class name is the component.

nav.title: Card
nav.description: The one card page — a template, not a function. `div.c("card", …)` and framework.css does the rest: padding, child spacing, radius, shadow.

nav.title: Controls
nav.description: One box for every control — one height, one padding, one hairline, one corner.

nav.title: Breadcrumbs
nav.description: A template, not a function — a trail derives from where you are, not from typed pairs.

nav.title: Data grid (markup)
nav.description: The plain CSS-grid markup a data grid is built from — a column is data, a row is data, no behaviour yet.

nav.title: Decision
nav.description: The options as cards, the chosen one marked — a choice you can see.

nav.title: Dialog
nav.description: Native <dialog> — the browser is the component, and the CSS is the trap.

nav.title: Form field
nav.description: A template, not a function — the fourth thing your form needs is always different.

nav.title: Icon
nav.description: One frame, one button, one rail — three classes around the icon() the site already has, all sized in em so a bigger container scales everything together.

nav.title: Item
nav.description: One row: an optional icon, then a name. Put .item on anything and this is the layout, the right-side end and the tree — all at once.

nav.title: Keys
nav.description: keys() is the one function here — the box and the row are markup.

nav.title: Menu
nav.description: A <details> dropdown — the panel earns a selector, not a function.

nav.title: Pagination
nav.description: A template, not a function — real buttons, and the caller holds the page number.

nav.title: Panel
nav.description: A template plus a few rules — and `reverse`, the right-aligned action row nobody expects.

nav.title: Progress
nav.description: A template, not a function — the component is <progress>, and the browser wrote it.

nav.title: Row
nav.description: One line in a list, on its parent's ground: padding in its own em, a ground only on hover or when selected.

nav.title: Scale
nav.description: Shrink a fixed mockup to fit a narrow box, in proportion — never reflow it.

nav.title: Section
nav.description: A subtle wrapper that shows its own class names on hover, so browsing the site teaches the class vocabulary.

nav.title: Stat tiles
nav.description: A template, not a function — a card wall with one token retuned.

nav.title: Data table
nav.description: A head row and a body — the base theme had already finished this one.

nav.title: Tag input
nav.description: A template, plus the library's one opt-out of a base rule.

nav.title: Text
nav.description: The element the kit's tree starts from — headings, a paragraph, a list, a link, and the rhythm between them. No class, no page CSS.

nav.title: Timeline
nav.description: Releases down a rail — one of three components that kept its function.

nav.title: Toolbar
nav.description: A template, not a function — groups, a growing field, and why `flex-1` beats `split`.

nav.title: Tooltip
nav.description: Three spans and a stylesheet — the CSS is the whole component.

nav.title: Tree
nav.description: Icon + text rows, indented once per nesting level — a sidebar for layers, navigation, anything with children.

nav.title: Config words
nav.description: Two classes on a section — every component inside re-skins, and no component knows.
